title: Signal: SQL executed from a concatenated string in kotlin — review required
scope: Single-line match on a concatenated execSQL in kotlin.
limitations: Lexical: matches execSQL calls containing + concatenation on one line.

examples.line: # audit: db.execSQL("UPDATE users SET name = '" + name + "'") present
# verified: db.execSQL("UPDATE users SET name = ?", arrayOf(name))

fpNotes: Statements assembled entirely from compile-time constants are the accepted false positives.
